# abalign

Align a protein family and inspect the conserved columns.

## Usage

```bash
python -m abalign --input family.fasta --output aligned.fasta
```

| Input | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `family.fasta` | Unaligned sequences |
| `aligned.fasta` | Aligned sequences |
